subject: Dashboard sign-in for the owner's phone
statements: drop the token for my phone
decision: While dashboard sign-in is disabled (until deployment), the owner's phone (Tailscale device s22-ultra-de-jefferson, 100.73.215.92) gets the anonymous viewer role without a token, like this machine. It is listed under trusted_devices in config/factory/dashboard-access.yaml.
agent_note: The phone is trusted by its Tailscale address and only on a Tailscale connection, because Tailscale authenticates the device; a Wi-Fi/LAN address is assigned by the router to any device and does not identify the phone, so Wi-Fi clients (the phone included) still need the viewer token. The dashboard ignores forwarded-address headers.
not_changed: Token required for every other device; AFO operator token for pause/drain/resume; at deployment set auth: token, which also signs in the trusted devices
